step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a differential pair (XM1, XM2) with an NMOS tail current source (XM4). The inputs are routed through PMOS transistors (XM3, XM5) with grounded gates, which act as closed switches forming part of the configurable interleaver routing network in the analog turbo decoder.

paper_reference.title: A 13.3Mb/s 0.35µm CMOS Analog Turbo Decoder IC with a Configurable Interleaver

paper_reported.value: 0.1dB (likely refers to ripple or error, not raw gain)

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current I_tail ≈ 210µA for Vbias=0.9V. I_d = 105µA per branch. gm ≈ 2*I_d/Vov ≈ 777µS. With an assumed 10kΩ load, Gain = gm*RL = 7.77 V/V = 17.8 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the load applied. Using a standard 10kΩ test load yields ~18dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at output: BW = 1 / (2 * π * RL * Cout). With RL=10kΩ and Cout ≈ 20fF (parasitics + 10fF load), BW ≈ 800 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Must be significantly higher than the 13.3Mb/s data rate to avoid intersymbol interference.
Calculated directly from the tail current source bias and dimensions.

delay.description: Propagation delay from differential input to differential output

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's reported delays are for the full decoder loop. A single diff pair stage will have sub-nanosecond delay in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC differential gain, bandwidth, and transient propagation delay of the differential amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Analog Turbo Decoder Diff Pair
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 LABEL_NET_0 N2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 LABEL_NET_3 N1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 GND LABEL_NET_4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 GND LABEL_NET_6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9

* Loads (Added to convert OTA currents to measurable voltages)
RL1 VDD LABEL_NET_0 10k
RL2 VDD LABEL_NET_3 10k
CL1 LABEL_NET_0 0 10f
CL2 LABEL_NET_3 0 10f

* Inputs
V_INP LABEL_NET_4 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 10Meg)
V_INN LABEL_NET_6 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 10Meg)

* Differential signal extractors (VCVS)
E_diff OUT_DIFF 0 LABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_0 1.0
E_indiff IN_DIFF 0 LABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_6 1.0

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1k 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10k
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 0.1n 200n
  meas tran delay trig v(IN_DIFF) val=0 rise=1 targ v(OUT_DIFF) val=0 rise=1
  meas tran vout_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
  meas tran vout_min min v(OUT_DIFF)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
